book_title: Five Years Next Sunday (short story, in Disruption: New Short Fiction from Africa)
subject_line: The hair and the drought in "Five Years Next Sunday"
email_body:
Dear Idza,

In "Five Years Next Sunday" you introduce your protagonist through her hair and then widen out to a drought and a coastal community that both shuns and depends on her.

I would like to ask how Mombasa and the coast shape your stories, and whether your debut novel stays there.

book_title: For What Are Butterflies Without Their Wings (Masobe Books, 2022)
subject_line: The lake in the title story of For What Are Butterflies Without Their Wings
email_body:
Dear Troy,

The title story of For What Are Butterflies Without Their Wings, where a sister relives two decades of rivalry after her brother disappears in a lake, won the first Nyanza Literary Festival Prize in 2016, years before the book appeared.

I would be curious how that early story, and the lake country around Kisumu, shaped the rest of the collection.

book_title: In This Fragile World: Swahili Poetry of Commitment by Ustadh Mahmoud Mau (Brill, 2023; eds. Annachiara Raia and Clarissa Vierke)
subject_line: Mashairi ya In This Fragile World na jamii ya Lamu
email_body:
Mpendwa Ustadh Mahmoud,

Nimesoma kuhusu In This Fragile World, mkusanyiko wa mashairi yako uliochapishwa na Brill mwaka 2023, yaliyoandikwa kwa hati za Kiarabu na kugawanywa katika maudhui kama masuala ya kijamii, umuhimu wa elimu na dua. Inaonekana kila shairi linazungumza moja kwa moja na jamii ya Lamu.

Ningependa kujua jinsi unavyoamua kwamba jambo fulani katika jamii linahitaji shairi, hasa kuhusu elimu.

The Author Ledger ni mradi huru unaochapisha makala fupi za kuwatambulisha waandishi (Author Spotlights). Picha ya mwandishi hujengwa kupitia maswali machache ya maandishi, ambayo unaweza kuyajibu kwa wakati wako, na maandishi kamili hukuletea uyapitie kabla ya kuchapishwa.

Je, ungependa kushiriki? Hakuna shinikizo lolote.

Kwa heshima,
The Author Ledger
hook_note: Lamu poet and imam (b. 1952); 2023 Brill open-access collection of his Arabic-script Swahili poems grouped by themes incl. societal issues and education (ASC Leiden, OAPEN, ZMO search results).

subject_line: Bulei and Ferono in The Freedom of Birds
email_body:

I would like to ask how Ferono took shape alongside Bulei.

subject_line: Riwaya inayojitazama yenyewe: Dharau ya Ini
email_body:
Mpendwa Prof. Wamitila,

Nimesoma makala katika Tydskrif vir Letterkunde inayochambua Dharau ya Ini kama riwaya inayojizungumzia yenyewe, yaani inayojitafakari kama kazi ya kubuni. Makala hiyo pia inaeleza kwamba ulichapisha riwaya kumi za Kiswahili kati ya 1999 na 2014.

Ningependa kukuuliza kama mbinu hiyo ya kujitazama ilikuwa uamuzi wa makusudi tangu mwanzo, na jinsi ilivyokua katika riwaya zako zilizofuata.

The Author Ledger ni mradi huru unaochapisha makala fupi za kuwatambulisha waandishi (Author Spotlights). Picha ya mwandishi hujengwa kupitia maswali machache ya maandishi, ambayo unaweza kuyajibu kwa wakati wako, na maandishi kamili hukuletea uyapitie kabla ya kuchapishwa.

Je, ungependa kushiriki? Hakuna shinikizo lolote.

Kwa heshima,
The Author Ledger
hook_note: Academic study 'Metatextualities in the Kenyan Swahili novel' reads Dharau ya Ini (2007) as metatextual; notes ten Swahili novels 1999-2014 (Tydskrif vir Letterkunde search result). Recent activity not verified.
